result:
I’d make **empathy a prerequisite for power**.

Not politeness or vague compassion—actually having to reckon with the lives your decisions affect. The person closing a hospital, poisoning a neighborhood, or sending others into danger shouldn’t be able to treat people as costs, statistics, or acceptable losses.

I think a lot of cruelty survives because it’s easy for those in power never to have to feel its weight.
